steps.text: Okay. Six people in your room, and nobody is dancing. Fix it. Press play on the left deck.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: There we go. Hear the kick? One, two, three, four. That's a bar. The four little lamps count it for you. Let four bars go by.
steps.task: LISTEN: COUNT FOUR BARS

steps.text: Now the second record. Records are built in blocks, and every block starts on the one. Wait for the first lamp, then press play on the right deck. Right on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Nope. That was not the one. Press cue on the right deck, wait for the first lamp, and go again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Yes! Right on it. Nobody can hear it yet, the crossfader is all the way left. And the sync button keeps the two in time. For now.
steps.task: ON THE ONE

steps.text: Now bring it in. Slide the crossfader to the middle. Slowly.
steps.task: CROSSFADER TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Hear that? Two records, one beat. That's a mix.
steps.task: TWO RECORDS, ONE BEAT

steps.text: Now go all the way to the right, and let the first record go.
steps.task: CROSSFADER ALL THE WAY RIGHT

steps.text: And stop the left deck.
steps.task: STOP THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Your first mix! And look. Sara is dancing.
steps.task: FIRST MIX

steps.text: Round two. Same room, same six people, and now they expect something. Start the left deck.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Listen. Bars come in blocks of eight. That's a phrase. At the end of one you hear a little whoosh, and the kick drops out for a beat. That's the record telling you something new is coming.
steps.task: LISTEN FOR THE END OF THE PHRASE

steps.text: The next record has to start where a phrase starts, or the two will change at different times, and it sounds like an argument. The right fader is down, so nobody hears it yet. Press play on the right deck, on the first beat of a new phrase.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: That's it! Now they change together. Bring it in. Push the right channel fader up, slowly.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Both records, same phrase. Now wait for the next whoosh, and pull the left fader all the way down.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: Clean. Stop the left deck.
steps.task: STOP THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: That was a real mix. On the phrase. Mira just looked up from her phone. That never happens.
steps.task: ON THE PHRASE

steps.text: Lesson three. The three knobs next to each fader. Start the left deck, and I'll show you.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Low is the kick and the bassline. Mid is the body. High is the hats. Now drag the left low knob all the way down.
steps.task: LEFT LOW KNOB ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Hear that? The floor just fell out. Put it back in the middle.
steps.task: LEFT LOW KNOB BACK TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Here's the thing. Two basslines at the same time is mud. So the next record comes in without its bass. Turn the right low knob all the way down.
steps.task: RIGHT LOW KNOB ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Good. Now start the right deck on a new phrase, like last time.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Fader up. Hear how it slides in on top? No fight.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Now the swap. When the phrase changes: left low down, right low back to the middle. Two hands, one move.
steps.task: AT THE NEXT PHRASE: LEFT LOW DOWN, RIGHT LOW TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Yes! That is the bass swap. Now pull the left fader all the way down.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN

steps.text: And stop the left deck.
steps.task: STOP THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Clean. Every DJ you love does that all night long. And Sara is still dancing, which is the whole point.
steps.task: THE BASS SWAP

steps.text: Lesson four. Headphones. Wired ones, Bluetooth is too slow. Top right, tap PHONES, and choose split.
steps.task: TAP PHONES (TOP RIGHT) AND CHOOSE SPLIT

steps.text: Now your left ear is the room, and your right ear is yours alone. Start the left deck.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Under the right fader there's a button that says PHONES. Press it.
steps.task: PRESS PHONES UNDER THE RIGHT FADER

steps.text: The right fader is down. So start the right deck whenever you like. The room hears nothing. Only you.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK

steps.text: That is the whole trick. You get to be wrong in private. Now do it properly. Press cue, and start it on a new phrase.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Now the little orange knob between the two PHONES buttons. Drag it up to the middle. That brings the room into your right ear too, so you hear the mix before anybody else.
steps.task: CUE MIX KNOB TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Sounds right? Then give it to the room. Right fader up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: And at the next phrase, left fader down.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: And stop the left deck.
steps.task: STOP THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: That's how every DJ on earth does it. You heard it first. They only heard it right.
steps.task: IN YOUR EARS

steps.text: Rita's garage. Borrowed speakers, two records on the decks, and people already moving. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Sara wants the one with the congas. Everybody has a request. The good ones, you play. Tap CRATE, top right.
steps.task: TAP CRATE (TOP RIGHT)

steps.text: Find Conga Line, and put it on the right deck. The right one isn't playing, so it's free.
steps.task: CRATE: CONGA LINE ON THE RIGHT DECK

steps.text: Now press SYNC on the right deck, so it follows the left one.
steps.task: PRESS SYNC ON THE RIGHT DECK

steps.text: Start it on a new phrase. The fader's down, so nobody hears it yet.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Now push the right fader up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Look at her. That's what a request is for.
steps.task: REQUEST PLAYED

steps.text: My shop, my decks. And no sync button, kid. Records don't have one. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Now the right one. On the one, like your friend taught you. Both faders are up, so the whole shop hears it.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: That wasn't the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Hear that? Horses galloping. Two kicks that won't agree. The right record is faster. A hundred and twenty four, against a hundred and twenty two.
steps.task: LISTEN: THE KICKS GALLOP

steps.text: Slow it down. Push the right pitch fader up, a little at a time, until the two numbers match. For small moves, keep your finger to the side of the fader.
steps.task: RIGHT PITCH FADER UP UNTIL BOTH SAY 122.0

steps.text: Same speed now. But the kicks still don't land together. Touch the dotted rim of the right record. A little push forward, or hold it back, until you hear one kick. Then keep it there.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD'S RIM UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: There. One kick. That's beatmatching. Nobody learns that from a button.
steps.task: BEATMATCHED

steps.text: Give the shop the new record. Crossfader all the way right.
steps.task: CROSSFADER ALL THE WAY RIGHT

steps.text: And stop the left one.
steps.task: STOP THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Not bad, kid. Saturday, ten o'clock. Don't be late.
steps.task: SYNC OFF

steps.text: No numbers today, kid. I've covered them up. Records don't come with a screen. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Now the right one, on the one. Both faders are up.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Listen. Which one is running ahead? Don't look for an answer. Listen for it.
steps.task: LISTEN: WHICH ONE IS AHEAD?

steps.text: Bring them to the same speed with the right pitch fader. Small moves, finger to the side. When the galloping slows to a crawl, you're close.
steps.task: MATCH THE SPEED WITH THE RIGHT PITCH FADER

steps.text: Now lock the kicks with the rim, and keep them there. By ear.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: That's it. You did that without a single number. Now you're a DJ.
steps.task: BY EAR

steps.text: Two records at the same tempo never stay together for long. Belts slip, motors wander. Start both, the right one on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Now the right one, on the one. Both faders are up.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Match them, then lock them. Then hold it. Eight bars, and don't let it slip. Little touches. Listen for the flam before it becomes a gallop.
steps.task: HOLD THE BLEND FOR EIGHT BARS

steps.text: Eight bars. Steady hands. That's how you hold a blend for a whole record.
steps.task: HOLD IT

steps.text: A pub on a Tuesday. Nobody's here to dance. They're here to drink, and you're here to make it nicer. That means long blends. Start the left record.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: First, take the bass out of the right one. Low knob, all the way down.
steps.task: RIGHT LOW KNOB ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Now start it on a new phrase. Its fader is halfway, so you can hear what you're doing.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Lock the kicks. Nudge the rim until they're one.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: Good. Now the right fader all the way up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: And now: patience. Sixteen bars of both records together. Kicks locked, one bassline. Let them talk to each other.
steps.task: BLEND FOR SIXTEEN BARS

steps.text: Now hand over the bass, on the phrase. Left low down, right low back to the middle.
steps.task: AT THE NEXT PHRASE: LEFT LOW DOWN, RIGHT LOW TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Left fader down. And that, my friend, was three minutes of nobody noticing anything. That's the job.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN

steps.text: This is radio. Nobody can see you, so every second counts. Start the left record.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Top right, there's a JINGLE button. The station ID. Fire it at the end of a phrase, so it lands between two blocks.
steps.task: JINGLE (TOP RIGHT) AT THE END OF A PHRASE
steps.missText: Middle of a phrase. Wait for the whoosh, then fire it.

steps.text: Now the next record, on a new phrase. Its fader's down, sync is on.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Bring it in. Right fader up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Now the hard part. The news starts on the hour. When the countdown hits zero, your music is out. Not before, not after. Both faders down, right on zero.
steps.task: BOTH FADERS DOWN WHEN THE COUNTDOWN HITS ZERO
steps.missText: Too early. That's dead air before the news. Faders back up, and try again.
steps.lateText: Too late. You stepped on the news. Faders back up, and try again.

steps.text: Bang on time. That's radio.
steps.task: ON AIR

steps.text: CAVE. I played here in ninety-four. At two in the morning there'll be nine hundred people in this cellar. Right now there's thirty, and they haven't decided to stay. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Look what's on the right deck. Sem Lista. That's a two o'clock record. You're the warm-up, kid. Make them want the headliner. Don't try to be her. Tap CRATE.
steps.task: TAP CRATE (TOP RIGHT)

steps.text: Pick the next one. Not the biggest. One step up from what's playing. Read the sleeves.
steps.task: CRATE: ONE STEP UP, ON THE RIGHT DECK
steps.missText: Too hot. That's a record for two in the morning. Find the one that's only a little warmer.

steps.text: Fila. A little faster, a little warmer. Start it on a new phrase. Its fader is halfway, so you can hear it.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Middle of a phrase. Cue it, wait for the whoosh, and go again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: It's faster than the room. Push the right pitch fader up until both say a hundred and twenty two. Warm-ups don't rush.
steps.task: RIGHT PITCH FADER UP UNTIL BOTH SAY 122.0

steps.text: Now lock the kicks with the rim.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: Locked. Right fader all the way up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: And at the next phrase, the left fader down.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: Look at them. Nodding, not screaming. That's a warm-up. Leave the screaming for Helena.
steps.task: WARM-UP

steps.text: Friday, peak time. CAVE has club players, so sync is back. Today isn't about your hands. It's about your ears. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Now the right one, on the one. Both faders are up.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Hear that? Same beat, but the notes fight. Sour. Oito Oito is in E flat minor, Sem Lista is in A minor. They will never agree.
steps.task: LISTEN: THE NOTES FIGHT

steps.text: Stop the right one.
steps.task: STOP THE RIGHT DECK

steps.text: Open the crate. Every sleeve has a key, a number and a letter. Oito Oito is 2A. Its friends sit next to it on the wheel: 1A, 3A, or 2B, the same number with the other letter. Find one.
steps.task: CRATE: A 1A, 3A OR 2B ON THE RIGHT DECK
steps.missText: That one fights. Look for a 1A, a 3A, or a 2B.

steps.text: Madrugada. 2B, and 128, like Oito Oito. Speed a record up and its notes go up too, so the tempo has to be close. Start it on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Hear that? Same beat, and now the notes agree. That's mixing in key.
steps.task: LISTEN: THE NOTES AGREE

steps.text: Take the left one out at the next phrase.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: The numbers help. But your ears heard it first.
steps.task: KEYS

steps.text: Your first Friday. I'll stay for the first hour. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: See the knob at the bottom, under the EQ? The filter. Drag it down, all the way. Hear the record sink, like it's under water? That's a low-pass.
steps.task: LEFT FILTER ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Now bring it back up to the middle. Slowly. Let the room feel it open.
steps.task: LEFT FILTER BACK TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: The right one now, on the one. Its fader is down, and sync is on.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Before anyone hears it, drag its filter up, all the way. High-pass. Only the hats get through.
steps.task: RIGHT FILTER ALL THE WAY UP

steps.text: Fader up. Nothing fights: it has no bass yet.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Now the swap. Drag the left filter up, all the way. It thins out and lets go of the bass.
steps.task: LEFT FILTER ALL THE WAY UP

steps.text: And open the right one. Its filter back down to the middle. The bass is all theirs now.
steps.task: RIGHT FILTER BACK TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Left fader down, at the next phrase.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: Double tap the left filter to put it back in the middle, for next time.
steps.task: DOUBLE TAP THE LEFT FILTER

steps.text: That's a filter mix. Use it like salt. A little, and not on everything.
steps.task: FILTER

steps.text: Six in the morning. The ones still here want to float, not run. We're going from 128 down to 120, and nobody's going to notice. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: The right one is Manhã. It's 120, but sync has pushed it up to 128. Start it on the one. Its fader is down.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Its intro is only drums. No notes to fight, so being pushed up doesn't hurt. Fader up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Left one out, at the next phrase.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: Now the slow part. Push the right pitch fader up, towards 120. A little every bar. Finger to the side for small moves.
steps.task: RIGHT PITCH FADER UP TO 120, A LITTLE EVERY BAR
steps.missText: Too fast! Everyone felt the brakes. Slower. A little every bar.

steps.text: 120. Nobody noticed, and everybody's floating. That's an afterhours.
steps.task: TEMPO

steps.text: Playing other people's records is half of it. Now make your own. This is a drum machine: three rows, sixteen steps, one bar. Press play on the left deck.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Nothing yet. Tap the kick on every beat: steps 1, 5, 9 and 13. Four on the floor.
steps.task: KICK ON 1, 5, 9 AND 13

steps.text: Now the clap, on two and four. Steps 5 and 13.
steps.task: CLAP ON 5 AND 13

steps.text: And the hats, between the kicks. Steps 3, 7, 11 and 15. The off-beat.
steps.task: HATS ON 3, 7, 11 AND 15

steps.text: Hear that? That's a groove. Every house record you love started exactly like this.
steps.task: DRUMS

steps.text: Your drums are still here. Press play.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Now the notes. Tap SYNTH, on the left of the grid.
steps.task: TAP SYNTH (LEFT OF THE GRID)

steps.text: The bass goes where the kick isn't. Between the kicks: steps 3, 7, 11 and 15.
steps.task: BASS ON 3, 7, 11 AND 15

steps.text: Now add one on step 1, with the kick. Listen.
steps.task: ADD A BASS NOTE ON STEP 1

steps.text: Hear the thump go muddy? Kick and bass, fighting for the same space. Take it off again.
steps.task: TAKE THE BASS OFF STEP 1

steps.text: Chords. A stab on steps 4 and 12, just before the clap. It pushes the groove forward.
steps.task: CHORD ON 4 AND 12

steps.text: Drums, bass, chords. That's a track. Next, we make it a record.
steps.task: BASS AND CHORDS

steps.text: This is your loop. One bar, over and over. A record needs more than that: an intro, a build, a break. Press play.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: On the left of the grid there's a CUT button. It cuts your loop onto a dubplate: a whole record. Tap it.
steps.task: TAP CUT (LEFT OF THE GRID)

steps.text: Cut. Play it from the top.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Listen. Only kick and hats in the intro. Then the clap and the bass. Then everything, a break with the chords, and back. That's an arrangement.
steps.task: LISTEN: YOUR RECORD

steps.text: It's in your crate now. One copy, nobody else has it. Saturday, we play it at CAVE.
steps.task: DUBPLATE

steps.text: Berlin. Joli's booth. The left channel fader is dead, stuck at full. So tonight you mix with the crossfader. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: The crossfader is all the way left, so nobody hears the right deck. Start it on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Nope. That was not the one. Press cue on the right deck, wait for the first lamp, and go again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: It's slower. Bring the right pitch fader down until both say 130.
steps.task: RIGHT PITCH FADER DOWN UNTIL BOTH SAY 130.0

steps.text: Lock the kicks with the rim.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: Now the crossfader to the middle. Slowly.
steps.task: CROSSFADER TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: Two basslines. Take the left low down, on the phrase.
steps.task: AT THE NEXT PHRASE: LEFT LOW DOWN

steps.text: Crossfader all the way right.
steps.task: CROSSFADER ALL THE WAY RIGHT

steps.text: Every booth is broken somewhere. The good ones mix anyway.
steps.task: BORROWED BOOTH

steps.text: Ibiza, sunset. Canal is Amsterdam, 126. The terrace wants Sal: Balearic, 120, another key. You can't blend those. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: When two records don't fit, you don't blend them. You hand over. First, thin the left one out: its filter up, about halfway.
steps.task: LEFT FILTER UP, ABOUT HALFWAY

steps.text: Now start Sal on a new phrase. The crossfader is left, so nobody hears it yet.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON A NEW PHRASE
steps.missText: Close, but that was the middle of a phrase. Press cue on the right deck, and wait for the whoosh.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Now the cut. On the next phrase, crossfader all the way right, in one move.
steps.task: AT THE NEXT PHRASE: CROSSFADER ALL THE WAY RIGHT

steps.text: Sal's intro takes over, and the terrace never heard the key change. When records don't fit, cut on the phrase.
steps.task: GENRE SWITCH

steps.text: A festival stage. The speakers out in the field are far away, so what comes back is late. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Hear the echo? That's the field, a seventh of a second behind. Never mix to the echo. Mix to the first hit, the one from your monitors. Start the right one on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and try again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Its fader is up halfway so you can hear it. It's faster: bring the right pitch fader up until both say 122.
steps.task: RIGHT PITCH FADER UP UNTIL BOTH SAY 122.0

steps.text: Lock the kicks. Listen to the first kick, not the echo.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: Right fader all the way up.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: And the left one out, on the phrase.
steps.task: LEFT CHANNEL FADER DOWN, AT THE NEXT PHRASE

steps.text: Out there, ten thousand people heard that late, and perfect. That's a big stage.
steps.task: THE DELAY

steps.text: Back to back. The left deck is mine, the right one is yours. Rule one: you never touch the other DJ's deck. Not the record, not the fader.
steps.task: LISTEN TO HELENA'S RECORD

steps.text: I'm playing Acordeão. Nine A. Answer it. In your bag there's one record that sits next to mine on the wheel. Put it on your deck.
steps.task: CRATE: A RECORD NEXT TO 9A, ON THE RIGHT DECK
steps.missText: That one fights my key. Try another.

steps.text: Start it on my phrase. Your fader is down, so nobody hears it yet.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON HER PHRASE
steps.missText: Not on my phrase. Cue it, and wait for the next one.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Your low all the way down first. One bassline at a time.
steps.task: RIGHT LOW ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Now bring your fader up. All the way.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: On my next phrase, I take my bass out. You put yours back in. Same moment.
steps.task: WHEN HER LOW GOES OUT: YOUR LOW TO THE MIDDLE

steps.text: And now I take my record out. My deck, my fader. Hands off.
steps.task: HANDS OFF: SHE TAKES HER RECORD OUT

steps.text: You answered me, and you never touched my deck. That's back to back.
steps.task: BACK TO BACK

steps.text: On a stage that big, a needle can skip. Most DJs freeze. Today you learn what to do. Start the left one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE LEFT DECK

steps.text: Same tempo, a hundred and twenty. Start the right one on the one.
steps.task: PRESS PLAY ON THE RIGHT DECK, ON THE ONE
steps.missText: Not the one. Cue it, and go again.
steps.missTask: PRESS CUE ON THE RIGHT DECK, THEN TRY AGAIN

steps.text: Lock the kicks with the rim.
steps.task: NUDGE THE RIGHT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: Take its low out first. One bassline.
steps.task: RIGHT LOW ALL THE WAY DOWN

steps.text: Now its fader up. Both records in the room.
steps.task: RIGHT CHANNEL FADER UP

steps.text: Hear that? Two records, one beat. Hold it.
steps.task: TWO RECORDS, ONE BEAT

steps.text: There! The needle jumped. The kicks are apart. Push the left record back with the rim. Now.
steps.task: NUDGE THE LEFT RECORD UNTIL THE KICKS ARE ONE

steps.text: That's all a skip is. A nudge, and a cool head. If it happens up there, you won't freeze.
steps.task: THE SKIP

keys.text: Sour! Those two don't fit. Cut on the phrase.

bag.text: Joli's records. Read the sleeves: the keys are on them.

wait.text: Another night, another city. Do you even remember which one?

start.text: Here we go. Easy does it.

slip.text: It's drifting, and you're not catching it.

cable.text: Even the turntables are tired tonight.

tired.text: You look terrible. When did you last sleep?

rough.text: Bumpy. Nine hundred people heard that.
